description: Findings 1 and 4. Stop logging cookies, session ids, session contents, tokens and push-subscription endpoints/keys (keep user id/name/route/status logs and overall log volume), add ONE startup warning when production/non-demo runs on the committed fallback SESSION_SECRET / VAPID keys (names only, never values; fallbacks and values are NOT changed), and add a 'Rotating secrets' section to DEPLOYMENT.md. Independent of FEAT-002/003. Line numbers are at base 91e02a6.
steps: First (before any edit) regenerate the route baseline per plan F5.1 into %TEMP%\harden-routes-before.txt and confirm it equals the parent workspace's server-split-routes-before.txt (66 lines). Keep your temp scripts in the worktree root as tmp-*.js and delete them at the end.

routes/auth.js: at L30-34 and L64-68 drop the `sessionID: req.sessionID` property from the 'Session saved successfully' logs (keep userId/username). At L184-190 (GET /api/auth) log only { userId, username }: remove sessionID, cookie (req.session.cookie) and headers (req.headers.cookie).
routes/pages.js L10-15: log only { userId, username } (drop sessionID and cookie).

routes/recipients.js: at L75, L94, L105 (POST /api/recipients) and L545, L596 (POST /api/user/identify) replace `session: req.session` / `'Session:', req.session` with `userId: req.session && req.session.userId` (keep the existing `body: req.body` / 'Request body:' parts; they only contain { name }).

lib/push.js: add and export `pushServiceHost(endpoint)` = try { return new URL(endpoint).host } catch (e) { return 'unknown' }. Use it in the log at L69 (`(endpoint: ${sub.endpoint.substring(0, 50)}...)` -> `(push service: ${pushServiceHost(sub.endpoint)})`) and in the L81-85 error object (`endpoint: sub.endpoint.substring(0, 50) + '...'` -> `pushService: pushServiceHost(sub.endpoint)`). Keep `module.exports` containing the existing two functions plus pushServiceHost.

routes/notifications.js: require pushServiceHost from '../lib/push' (extend the existing destructured require at L10). Edit ONLY L28 (demo subscribe log -> `{ userId, hasEndpoint: !!(subscription && subscription.endpoint) }`) and L48-51 (replace `endpoint: subscription.endpoint.substring(0, 50) + '...'` with `pushService: pushServiceHost(subscription.endpoint)`, keep hasKeys). Do not touch the debug/test route definitions (FEAT-002 owns them).

server.js error handler (L149-151): change `console.error('Server error:', err);` to log `err.message` only when `err && err.type === 'entity.parse.failed'` (body-parser attaches the raw request text as err.body), otherwise unchanged: `console.error('Server error:', err && err.type === 'entity.parse.failed' ? err.message : err);`. The responses below it are unchanged.

server.js: directly after the 'Session configuration:' console.log (L81-85) add the single startup warning from plan F4(a): collect missing SESSION_SECRET and missing VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY; if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' || !DEMO_MODE) && something is missing, ONE console.warn naming the variables only and pointing to DEPLOYMENT.md 'Rotating secrets'. Do NOT change `secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET || 'prezenty_secret'` (L90), lib/webpush-config.js or any secret value. Never print a secret value.

DEPLOYMENT.md: near the env var list (L27-28) add the missing VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY / VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY / VAPID_EMAIL entries; append a 'Rotating secrets' section: generate SESSION_SECRET with `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(48).toString('hex'))"`, generate VAPID keys with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys`, set SESSION_SECRET + VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY + VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (+ VAPID_EMAIL) in the host's environment settings (Render dashboard / Docker -e / Vercel env) and redeploy; consequences: new SESSION_SECRET invalidates every session so all users must log in again once; new VAPID pair makes old push subscriptions fail with 403, the server deletes them automatically and each device re-subscribes on its next visit, set both VAPID values together; why: the fallback values are committed to git. Note which deploy configs set what (render.yaml generates SESSION_SECRET, none set VAPID_*, vercel.json/Dockerfile set neither). README.md: one line near the SESSION_SECRET sample (L28) pointing to that section.

node --check every edited JS file; run the F1 static grep, the F1 demo-mode sentinel run, the F1 fake-DB sentinel run, and the F4 boot scenarios (demo+development: no [SECURITY] line and boot output otherwise unchanged; OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=production: exactly one [SECURITY] line; all three env vars set: none; fake-DB non-demo: one line). Delete all tmp-*.js files.

Commit: `git add` the edited files by name (NOT .agents/, NOT tmp files). Message e.g. `fix(security): Redact session and push data from logs`, body explaining what/why, no sim trailer, do not push. Set this FEAT's status to completed and record findings.
acceptance_criteria: No console.* call in server.js, routes/ or lib/ prints req.headers.cookie, req.sessionID, req.session.cookie, the whole req.session object, a push subscription object, keys, or any part of a push endpoint beyond its host

Runtime sentinel runs (demo and fake-DB) show none of: the session cookie value, session id, SENTINEL_ENDPOINT_TOKEN, SENTINEL_P256, SENTINEL_AUTH, SENTINEL_PW in captured stdout/stderr, while 'Auth check: User IS authenticated' style user lines are still printed

Exactly one [SECURITY] warning line is printed at boot in production or non-demo mode when SESSION_SECRET or VAPID env vars are missing, names the variables only, and never contains 'prezenty_secret' or any VAPID key material; nothing is printed in demo+development
SESSION_SECRET fallback, VAPID fallback keys and server cookie/session options are byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff shows no change to those lines)
DEPLOYMENT.md has a 'Rotating secrets' section with both generation commands and the consequences
Ordered route list unchanged (66 routes, identical to the baseline)
verification: node --check server.js routes/auth.js routes/pages.js routes/recipients.js routes/notifications.js lib/push.js (each exits 0)
Demo boot (OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=development) -> GET /health 200 and the sentinel assertions in plan F1 step 2 pass
Fake-DB boot sentinel assertions (plan F1 step 3) pass
F4 boot-scenario matrix (plan F4 Verification) behaves as specified
Route list diff vs baseline is empty
findings: Committed as 88fe42b on fix/harden-server-1 (8 files, not pushed). Route baseline regenerated from untouched HEAD: 66 routes, identical to the parent workspace server-split-routes-before.txt; saved at %TEMP%\harden-routes-before.txt (and after FEAT-001 at %TEMP%\harden-routes-after.txt, diff empty). The walker (tmp-routes.js, deleted) wrapped express.application.listen to capture app, set OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=development, required ./server.js, and walked app._router.stack into routers; recreate it for FEAT-002/final checks. Verified: node --check on all 6 JS files; static grep clean (only label strings 'Session:' in pages.js and lib/auth.js remain); demo sentinel run OK (health 200, no cookie value/sid/SENTINEL_* in output, 'Auth check: User IS authenticated' still printed); fake-DB production sentinel run OK incl. lib/push.js path via POST /api/test-notification (logs 'push service: fcm.googleapis.com'); F4 matrix: demo+development 0 [SECURITY] lines, OFFLINE+production 1 line (names SESSION_SECRET and VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY), all three set 0, only SESSION_SECRET set 1 (VAPID only), fake-DB non-demo 1; no 'prezenty_secret' or VAPID key material in any output. Notes for later steps: (1) files use CRLF; str_replace edits preserved it (checked bareLF=0), keep checking. (2) POST /api/test-notification is a handy way to reach lib/push.js in a fake-DB run; with FEAT-002's debugOnly it will 404 in non-demo production, so use NODE_ENV=development for such runs. (3) Fake-DB preload approach used: Module._load hook for mysql2/promise (pool.execute dispatching on SQL; users row with bcryptjs hash of 'pw'), express-mysql-session (class extends session.MemoryStore) and web-push (sendNotification rejects {statusCode:500}). (4) Demo POST /api/user/identify still 500 (pre-existing, out of scope). (5) pushServiceHost is exported from lib/push.js. (6) Edits also changed recipients.js L94/L105/L596 labels from 'Session:' to 'User ID:' with req.session && req.session.userId. (7) No .env exists in the worktree. Temp scripts deleted; .agents/ not staged.
